title: mysql+pyodbc character set sniffing query now throws TypeError
body:
Using SQLAlchemy built from current master (2c34d25), this code

```python
import sys

from sqlalchemy import __version__ as sa_version, create_engine, text

print(sys.version)
# 3.7.4 (tags/v3.7.4:e09359112e, Jul  8 2019, 20:34:20) [MSC v.1916 64 bit (AMD64)]

print(f'SQLAlchemy {sa_version}, pandas {pd.__version__}, pyodbc {pyodbc.version}')
# SQLAlchemy 1.4.0b1, pandas 0.25.1, pyodbc 4.0.27

sqlalchemy_url = 'mysql+pyodbc://@hpMySQL'
engine = create_engine(sqlalchemy_url, echo=False)
result = engine.execute(text("SELECT 1 AS foo")).fetchone()
print(result)
```
